name: online_research_extract_model_scores
notes: Model benchmark signal extraction from research snippets. Harness traces a faithful C copy of src/tools/research_helpers.c::research_extract_model_scores. Inputs restricted to well-formed percentages: documented divergences excluded — (a) context containing ONLY out-of-range pcts (e.g. '200%') yields no entry in LIVE Python but a 0.5 default boost in C; (b) malformed tokens like '5..%' parse differently via atof vs float().
